Priority should be set on obtaining the only object known to possess Compound 3.|[[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]'s notes of '''Serum Zero''' from the [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]] Trailer}} }} ==Description== '''Serum Zero''' is the chemical agent that is responsible for the creation of the zombies in the Tower Defense Simulator story. The serum was developed by Oasis X Enterprise under the lead of [[Patient Zero (Story)|Dr. Herrschaft]].{{InlineQuote|From what I can tell, [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]'s virus has started to evolve.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 11 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}}
{{InlineQuote|Wait... What if [[[[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]|Dr. Herrschaft]] is [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]?|[[Professor V]] on Wave 25 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} Its original purpose for creation is unclear, but it is compared to other "''Bio-enhancing serums''" developed by Oasis X Enterprise. [[Patient Zero (Story)|Dr. Herrschaft]], after becoming [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]], seemingly wrangled control of the serum's supply and uses it as a biological weapon to cause chaos. '''Serum Zero''' is comprised of three primary compounds, "''00''", "''Rain''", and a fragment of the [[God Cube]]. 00 and Rain act as vessels to spread the desired effects of the fragment. Before the [[God Cube]] fragment was introduced into the final version of the serum, other chemicals acted as substitutes for the third compound, however, they produced unwanted side effects. Alongside the three primary compounds are other stabilizers that have been used in past serums developed by Oasis X Enterprise. While '''Serum Zero''' is the origin of the zombie apocalypse in Tower Defense Simulator, in [[Intermediate Mode]] dialogue, the source of zombies is said to be through a virus."''From what I can tell, [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]'s virus has started to evolve. It'll definitely need to be studied, so drag me back a corpse or two?''" — [[Professor V]] on Wave 11 ([[Intermediate Mode]]) This could be explained by [[Patient Zero (Story)|Dr. Herrschaft]] having put the zombifying virus inside the serum secretly. ==Zombies== The hosts of '''Serum Zero''' are referred to as zombies in the story of Tower Defense Simulator. While they all originate from '''Serum Zero''', zombies come in many different forms, such as [[Normal|Normals]], [[Normal Boss|Normal Bosses]], [[Breaker2|Breakers]], [[Hidden|Hiddens]], [[Bolt|Bolts]], [[Ghoul|Ghouls]], and many more. It is currently unknown how '''Serum Zero''' spreads between hosts to infect people into zombies. Entities infected by the virus will mutate as time goes, transforming them.{{InlineQuote|Something's not right about the hoard. It looks like they've… mutated?|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 7 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} Mutations do not entirely replace the previous zombies, as the non-mutated forms can coexist with their mutated counterparts. Mutations result in an appearance change and enhanced strength.{{InlineQuote|The [[Abnormal]] zombie is a mutation from your basic zombie. It is faster and has more health than its predecessor, and can usually be found in your typical horde.|[[Abnormal]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} The following enemies are known to be mutations of other enemies: *[[Normal Boss]] is most likely a mutated version of the [[Normal]].{{InlineQuote|Commander, we have a visual of a mutated zombie heading towards you.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 6 ([[Casual Mode|Casual]])}} Its mutations result in larger size, and increased strength and health. *[[Abnormal]] is a mutated version of the [[Normal]]. Mutation results in an appearance change, increased speed and strength. *[[Quick]] is a mutated version of the [[Abnormal]]. Mutation resulted in it getting an appearance change, faster speed, increased strength and made it more aggressive.{{InlineQuote|The [[Quick]] zombie is a further mutation from the [[Abnormal]]. It is stronger and faster, leading it to sprint towards humans and other creatures. They are more aggressive than [[Normal]] and [[Abnormal]] zombies.|[[Quick]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} *[[Heavy]] is a mutation of an unspecified zombie, though through gameplay, specifically Wave 7 of [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode, the most likely option is it being a mutation of the [[Slow]]. However, due to the [[Quick]] not being a mutation of the [[Speedy]] like one would think but actually a mutation of the [[Abnormal]], this does definitively prove it being a mutation of the [[Slow]]. *[[Elite Abnormal]] is a mutation of an unspecified zombie, though through gameplay, specifically Wave 6 and 9 of [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode, the most likely option is it being a mutation of the [[Normal Boss]]. However, due to the [[Quick]] not being a mutation of the [[Speedy]] like one would think but actually a mutation of the [[Abnormal]], this does definitively prove it being a mutation of the [[Normal Boss]]. *[[Hidden]] is a mutation of an unspecified zombie.{{InlineQuote|Even after all these years, I'm still surprised by how many mutations there are. Some of them are almost completely invisible. They'll be showing up soon.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 8 ([[Casual Mode|Casual]])}} *Other zombies which are stronger variants of other zombies do exist, like the [[Hazmat]] and [[Elite Hazmat]], however there is no known information on them being a mutation of another zombie. Therefore, no such enemies will be listed here without confirmation. The initial batch of zombies produced by early versions of the serum resulted in the creation of the [[Ghoul|Ghouls]], [[Living Experiment|Living Experiments]], [[Reaver|Reavers]], and [[Failed Experiment|Failed Experiments]] seen in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]].The [[Ghoul]] and [[Living Experiment]] are shown inside experiment rooms, locked there before the '''Serum Zero''' with [[God Cube]] as Compound 3 was made, meaning they were made with a prototype serum.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vk7eFSlSzNA While the zombies produced by the final version of the serum resulted in the standard ones seen in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]] and [[Molten Mode|Molten]]{{InlineQuote|The zombies must be attracted to all the noise we're making.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 7 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} modes gameplay. The stark design difference between the four experimental zombie types and the streamlined ones is explained by the unwanted side effects caused by the prototype serums. ==Owners== ===Oasis X Enterprise=== {{StoryGroupInfobox |title = Oasis X Enterprise |image = Oasisserumzero.jpg |category = hide }} Oasis X Enterprise was the initial group in possession of '''Serum Zero''', as they were the ones to create it. While [[Patient Zero (Story)|Dr. Herrschaft]] perfected and produced the final version of the serum, it is unknown who, and how many scientists were responsible for the creation of previous iterations of the serum. {{Clear}} ===T.D.S. Organization=== {{StoryGroupInfobox |title = T.D.S. Organization |image = Tdsserumzero.jpg |category = hide }} The [[T.D.S. Organization]] intercepted a package of '''Serum Zero''' that was attempted to be released in [[Cyber City]]. It is unknown if this is the first time that the organization acquired the serum, or if they have more samples. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] has most likely recovered the bodies of some of the zombies they have killed, which would allow them to study '''Serum Zero''' from their corpses. {{Clear}} ==Story== ===Unknown=== Oasis X Enterprise's laboratories begin synthesis on '''Serum Zero''' prototypes for an unknown purpose, but the results of the serum do not live up to what is desired from it. ===[[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]] Trailer=== A [[God Cube]] fragment was procured by [[Patient Zero (Story)|Dr. Herrschaft]], which he uses to synthesize the final version of '''Serum Zero'''. He tests the newly created serum on himself and becomes [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]. ===Unknown=== '''Patient Zero''' releases '''Serum Zero''' in various cities, beginning the zombie apocalypse.{{InlineQuote|I mean, it wasn't until after the zombies started taking over the cities...|[[Professor V]] on Wave 25 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} After an unspecified amount of time, the virus housed inside '''Serum Zero''' begins to mutate, bringing rise to new zombie types. The rise of new zombies led to many cities around the [[Overworld]] becoming overrun and destroyed.{{InlineQuote|That's how a lot of our cities were destroyed. Make sure nothing can get by us.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 8 ([[Casual Mode|Casual]])}} ===Hacker Trailer=== '''Serum Zero''' is intended to be released into [[Cyber City]] to destroy its population, but the sample is recovered by the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. ===Intermediate Mode=== The virus housed inside '''Serum Zero''' begets another mutation, bringing rise to the abnormal family of zombies, which include the [[Abnormal]], [[Quick]], [[Heavy]] and [[Elite Abnormal]]. ==Trivia== *It is alluded that the infection caused by '''Serum Zero''' is called the "''Oasis Plague.''"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihRKUNdtGBg *Compound 1's chemical formula shares a striking resemblance to [[wp:Heroin|diamorphine]]. *Compound 2's chemical formula shares a striking resemblance to [[wp:Codeine|codeine]]. ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}}
